rules.reference: Rhino Security Labs / Bishop Fox IAM Vulnerable
rules.description: Principal has permission to pass an IAM role to an EC2 instance and launch instances, allowing credential extraction via instance metadata.
rules.narrative_template: {source} can become admin in {hops} hops: passes {target} to a new compute instance and extracts credentials.

rules.reference: Rhino Security Labs - IAM Privilege Escalation Vector #1
rules.description: Principal has iam:CreatePolicyVersion, permitting creation of a new default policy version with unrestricted administrator privileges.
rules.narrative_template: {source} can directly grant itself administrative access by creating an unrestricted version on policy {target}.

rules.reference: Rhino Security Labs - IAM Privilege Escalation Vector #2
rules.description: Principal can switch default version of an attached customer-managed policy to an existing version with higher privileges.
rules.narrative_template: {source} can switch policy {target} default version to an existing version possessing higher permissions.

rules.reference: Rhino Security Labs - IAM Privilege Escalation Vector #4 & #5
rules.description: Principal can attach AdministratorAccess or other highly privileged managed policies directly to itself or a controlled principal.
rules.narrative_template: {source} can attach the AdministratorAccess policy to {target} to achieve full administrative control.

rules.reference: Rhino Security Labs - IAM Privilege Escalation Vector #6 & #7
rules.description: Principal can create or update inline policies, allowing injection of an Allow *:* statement.
rules.narrative_template: {source} can inject an inline administrator policy into {target}, escalating privileges immediately.

rules.reference: Rhino Security Labs - IAM Privilege Escalation Vector #3
rules.description: Principal can generate an access key for an administrator user, allowing direct assumption of their administrative session.
rules.narrative_template: {source} can create active access keys for admin-equivalent user {target} and impersonate them.

rules.reference: Bishop Fox IAM Vulnerable & AWS IAM Trust Relationships
rules.description: Principal has trust permission to assume an admin-equivalent role directly or via lateral role pivot.
rules.narrative_template: {source} can assume admin-equivalent role {target} directly via STS AssumeRole.
